scope: Monocular image-based 2.5D integration simulation; reused training appearance. Not independent recognition evaluation or real-vehicle safety validation.
truth_access: Renderer and scorer only. Controller uses model masks/probabilities, their history, and simulated measured speed.
timing: Fixed simulated time; inference latency is measured but not injected into feedback. Not a real-time or delay-robustness claim.

reference_profile.name: BlueROV2 planar inspection reference with 4K Cam
reference_profile.scope: Published hardware references plus explicit uncalibrated planar simulation assumptions

published_vehicle.usage: Dimensional and propulsion reference, not a deep-sea pressure-rating claim

camera.model: Blue Robotics 4K Cam (wide setting, nominal pinhole)
camera.published_delay_test_setup: 1080p30 on 2024 M3 MacBook Air; not direct inference-input delay

simulation.delay_usage: Stress proxy only; do not equate display latency with measured camera-to-inference delay

assumption_notes: No calibrated lens distortion, housing refraction, current compensation or tether drag
Planar surge/yaw only; published lateral/heave abilities are not fully implemented
Stopping surge is not verified station keeping
Hydrostatic depth, pressure and lighting physics are not simulated

encounter_geometry: Original horizontal footprint stop rule plus evaluation-only fixed-height sphere clearance; no depth control

centerline_assumptions.control_center: projected currently accepted local path; independent of full-mask connected components
centerline_assumptions.raw_segmentation: unchanged complete p>0.5 before shared fish exclusion and motion compensation

synthetic_inspection_criteria.usage: scoring only, never fed to controller

appearance_manifest.photographic_material: full photograph with row-wise pipe rectification, reflected tiling; source labels are renderer material only
appearance_manifest.fish_annotation: manually outlined appearance sprite, not real-video evaluation ground truth

episodes.contact_metric: horizontal footprint overlap; not physical 3D collision
episodes.model_input: rendered RGB only; no ground-truth mask or world coordinates

event_times.association_caveat: Global first events; matching-based intervals are not proof of same-fish track identity.

episodes.sphere_metric: Assumed sphere envelopes at fixed heights; evaluation only. Episode still stops at original horizontal contact.
